__faion_header__.purpose: Weighted 2026 baseline rubric: one item per gating rule, each with weight + acceptance criterion

items.check: async server components wrap every data fetch in a Suspense boundary; no getServerSideProps-era idioms in new code
Python floor pinned at 3.12+; pyproject.toml is the single config file
ruff check . passes and mypy --strict (or pyright strict) runs in CI
pyproject.toml managed by uv or poetry with the lockfile committed; no raw pip in CI
.pre-commit-config.yaml present with format + lint + typecheck hooks
.aidocs/ present with constitution.md and a spec/design/test-plan set per feature
